narrative.overview: Rembero makes technical causality legible through white evidence surfaces, deep navy structure, cobalt execution, and amber provenance. Large declarative type introduces the idea while precise tables, code, proofs, and graphs demonstrate it.
keyCharacteristics: White evidence surfaces against navy structure
Graphs always have a readable list equivalent

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Amber never decorates; it appears only where a user can trace an answer to a source, rule, or proof edge.

dos: Do make storage, query, result, and proof visible together.
Do keep code and data code-native and keyboard reachable.
donts: Don't use generic dashboard cards as the primary structure.
Don't fabricate model calls, stored derivations, metrics, or customer proof.
